question: Where is the Sair-E-Gul Faroshan festival held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Phool Walon Ki Sair is also known as 'Sair-e-Gul Faroshan.'**
 
• **Phool Walon Ki Sair** was started in 1812 by the **Mughal Emperor Akbar II.**
 
• Phool Walon Ki Sair, which means "procession of florists" is celebrated annually in Delhi by the florists of Delhi.
 
• It is a three-day event which is held in **September**.
 
• It is celebrated by** both Hindus and Muslims.**
 
• It was last held in **1857**.
 
• It was restarted in **1962 **by the late **Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Akbar Shah II was the 18th Mughal Emperor of Iⁿdia.
 
• He was the son of Shah Alam II.
 
• He was born on 22 April 1760 and died on 28 September 1837.
 
• He reigned from 1806 to 1837. 
 
• During his time the East India Company took over the administration of India.
